text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Out with the old, in with the new, let's 
have funーー!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy yourselves to the fullest 
today!

text_block_list.name: Satono-Supporting Mother
text_block_list.text:
"My, the Satono young ladies...! 
Hohoho, my child and I both support the 
Satono family, you know."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Duoxie! Thank you as always. 
On behalf of the Satono family, I express 
our deepest gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, everyone~! 
I'm holding an autograph session! Please 
come on over~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah~~!! It's Kita-chan!! 
I made an advance reservation, so I'll be 
there once my time slot comes!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"(Kitasan is... as popular as ever. 
All right, I'll also――)"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"'To Kitasan-Love-Ko-san'... 
Ah, my writing might be a little crooked."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"It's totally fine! That just makes it 
even rarer! 
Um, more importantly, could you do 'that 
thing' you did for the person before me!?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Of course! 
All right, with lots of energy and 
cheer... Ready, go――"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Fan
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm always cheering for you, 
Duramente-san! 
The way you run, like you're totally 
overpowering everyone, is the absolute 
best――"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Is there anything you would like to do 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? Then, could we take a photo 
together!? 
P-Peace sign...!"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek! You actually did it for me! 
Thank you so much! I'll definitely come 
watch your next race!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: W-W-Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! Cheval-kun...!! 
What an unexpected outfit to welcome us 
in!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos made me wear this...! 
I mean... May I take your order...?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, Chevallie! 
You're a celeb, so you gotta act way more 
elegant!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval is still an apprentice right now. 
She's working as hard as she can, so 
please give her your support."

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text: "Of course! Go for it, Cheval-kun!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"All right then, chest out and look 
confident~. 
Imagine you're a supermodel, strike a bold 
pose!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't even know what a supermodel is 
like...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Brimming with confidence and super 
sparkly! 
See, just like this—bam!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... L-Like this...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoaa~...! You trying so hard is just too 
cute!!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval-chi is super fired up today to 
make sure all her fans have a great time! 
All right, next up, go for gorgeous!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Ngh...! P-Please... enjoy yourselves 
today...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text: "Thank you! We're gonna have a blast!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Whether it's the Cheval today or 
the usual Cheval, please continue to cheer 
her on."

text_block_list.name: Cheval's Fan
text_block_list.text: "Yes! We definitely will!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(...Thank goodness... they're happy. 
But... it's still so embarrassing...!)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I-I'm exhausted. 
I wonder if the fans... are having fun, at 
least...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So, this should be fine... right...? 
............Wait, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Duramente-san... 
What about the autograph session...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It is break time right now. 
Therefore, I am training."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... Even on a festival day... 
...That's amazing."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"(...Then again, today feels so out of the 
ordinary, 
maybe doing something familiar sounds 
nice...)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll do a light jog too...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Haa, haa, haa... 
...Are the fans enjoying themselves?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Um... I think it's going well. 
Everyone's smiling and seems satisfied..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I feel a similar response on my end. 
...Every fan who came by looked 
delighted."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You really seem capable of doing 
anything, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I said it's going well, but I'm just 
leaving everything to Big Sis and Vivlos. 
If they weren't there, I wouldn't even 
know how to please the fans..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Haa... haa... whew... 
Um... is something wrong...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I am the same. Kitasan, Satono, and 
the others liven up the mood, 
and I am merely riding their coattails."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"The fans are pleased and wear satisfied 
smiles. 
There is nothing wrong with that... or so 
it should be, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "(SCREEEEECH—!!! CRASH BANG BOOM!!)"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Wh-What was that!?
